mainText: Hello, Verona! At 8 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are looking at beautiful, clear skies with a temperature of 66 degrees, feeling like 68, perfect for outdoor activities at Badger Prairie County Park. Tonight features a waxing crescent moon, though we will not have any visible space station flyovers.

In city news, Verona is encouraging residents to go green. Apartment dwellers can easily drop off food waste at the Badger Prairie Food Scrap Stop. Meanwhile, the city is continuing its transportation upgrades, including anti-idling tech for our new ambulance and maintaining our Bronze Level Bicycle Friendly Community status.

We have great local events lined up. On July 19th, enjoy the Mount Horeb Art Fair or live music at Bailey's Run. Next week, do not miss the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market on July 22nd at Hometown Junction Park.
In the weekly police recap, on Friday, July 10th, officers and K9 Drea responded to a traffic stop on an equipment violation, which led to the seizure of marijuana and a citation for the driver.
For dessert, today's flavor of the day is Turtle. Culver's is currently closed but will open at 10 AM. If you are planning ahead, tomorrow's delicious flavor is Dark Chocolate Peanut Butter Crunch.
